name: LexisNexis
evidence: LexisNexis South Africa's own site presents the local operation as LexisNexis South Africa, offering legal, tax and business research products and services.
note_append: The roster records this employer as LexisNexis South Africa; that spelling is kept as an alias so the two resolve to one company rather than two employers.

name: Deloitte
note_append: The roster writes this employer several ways, including Deloitte (South Africa), Deloitte Consulting and Deloitte & Touche. All are kept as aliases on the one Deloitte record. Deloitte Consulting is a division of the same firm rather than a separate company, so it is recorded here as an alias, not as a subsidiary relationship.
evidence: Deloitte's South African site presents audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory and tax as services of one firm.
